sin.name: wall-clock-outside-time-source
sin.description: Code reads the wall clock itself, so a run that pins the journal's time, a replay or a simulation, sees two times at once and cannot replay.
sin.rule: Read the time from the TimeSource the constructor is given: time_source.seconds() for a number, time_source.moment() for a datetime; only TimeSource itself, the migrations and the clock offset to the team server read the wall clock.
